title: SVG + Canvas 2D Path2D morph stress test
blurb: Stress-tests normalizing and morphing 64-1,024 SVG path segments via getPathData({ normalize: true }) + setPathData() while mirroring the serialized path onto Canvas 2D via Path2D.
question: Can getPathData({ normalize: true }) + setPathData() drive real-time morphing across 64-1,024 normalized segments while mirroring the exact path onto a Canvas 2D stage via Path2D?
result: Normalization reduces arcs and quadratics into cubics for unified interpolation, while per-frame setPathData() dictionary allocation and d-string serialization scale linearly with segment count; Chrome 160 default-on frame times are not verified in Chrome 160.
testedIn: Chrome 153 behind --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI (getPathData/setPathData only); not verified in Chrome 160

friction.summary: getPathData({ normalize: true }) expands elliptical arcs into multiple cubics, changing segment counts before morphing
friction.repro: Switch between 64 and 1,024 segments and compare raw vs normalized segment counts in the readout; arc-lobe paths expand when normalized.
friction.workaround: Normalize both source and target paths first, convert remaining L segments to cubics, and subdivide the shorter array to match counts before interpolating.

friction.summary: Staged Chromium rollout and cross-engine gaps: getPathSegmentAtLength lags behind getPathData/setPathData, and Safari lacks the API
friction.repro: Open Live checks in Chrome 153 with --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI or in Safari; getPathSegmentAtLength is missing in 153 and all three methods are missing in Safari. Chromium also removes the d attribute on setPathData([]) while Firefox/explainer keep empty d.
friction.workaround: Feature-detect getPathData, setPathData, and getPathSegmentAtLength independently rather than assuming all three ship together.
